items.title: Walter Booker and Jimmy Cobb interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: But now there’s a host of young guys that’s in that idiom you know, killers. They’re really bad.

ctx.x: Yeah he means Jimmy Blanton and Oscar Pettiford.

He sounded like he was an extension, the modern extension of those guys. You know and then there’s guys, there’s Ron Carter. But now there’s a host of young guys that’s in that idiom you know, killers. They’re really bad.

Like see there was a time when they put the bass strings real close and they used to [scats] for about 30 years, or maybe 20 years. Now it’s come back, these young guys today, man they’ve got the bass strings up high again from the bridge, I mean from the fingerboard, and they thump now with beat, man. Matter of fact, they’re not even using amps anymore.
